preheader: How we help leaders make transformation choices with confidence.

blocks.text:
Hi {{first_name}},

Large technology programmes are expensive to correct once they are under way. Vitalos Consulting helps leaders get the direction right first: clear transformation choices, a realistic roadmap and a sound architecture before significant budget is committed.

Typical starting points include:
- Digital Transformation Discovery, to agree priorities and a practical roadmap
- Technology Health Assessment, for an independent view of your current estate
- AI Opportunity Assessment, to identify which AI use cases are worth pursuing
If {{organisation}} is facing a decision like this, I would be glad to arrange a short conversation. If not, a quick reply is enough and I will not follow up.
